title: Anthropic's $10B order for Google TPU racks from Broadcom

sources.quote: Broadcom CEO Hock Tan told investors during the vendor’s latest earnings call that Anthropic was the previously unnamed customer that had signed a $10 billion custom-chip deal earlier this year.

explain: Anthropic ordered $10B of complete server racks built around Google's Ironwood TPU chips, which Broadcom designs and sells. Broadcom first disclosed the order in September 2025 without naming the buyer; its CEO named Anthropic on the December 2025 earnings call.
